DI_ce_bulk_add_all_all = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { exists = var:DI_innovation_selected_culture }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player_character
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_military }
            every_in_global_list = {
                variable = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_military

            limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_civic }
            every_in_global_list = {
                variable = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_civic
                save_scope_as = innovation
                scope:player_character.var:DI_innovation_selected_culture = {
                    remove_innovation = scope:innovation
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_regional }
            every_in_global_list = {
                variable = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_regional
                save_scope_as = innovation
                scope:player_character.var:DI_innovation_selected_culture = {
                    remove_innovation = scope:innovation
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_other }
            every_in_global_list = {
                variable = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_other
                save_scope_as = innovation
                scope:player_character.var:DI_innovation_selected_culture = {
                    remove_innovation = scope:innovation
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_silk_road }
            every_in_global_list = {
                variable = DI_ce_innovations_tribal_silk_road
                save_scope_as = innovation
                scope:player_character.var:DI_innovation_selected_culture = {
                    remove_innovation = scope:innovation
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
